_doc: Golden panels Fab found defects in on the v4 overlays (2026-09-29). Their labels and curve grouping are being changed by the named findings; only the ink is still pinned (see test_rdson_gate_voltage_golden.py). Fab re-blesses them after he has seen the fix; nobody else removes an entry here.

entries.pending: re-bless: F-v2-1 (steep heads of filled-outline curves traced to the top frame)
entries.why: Rule-4 sweep of batch_all_v3: FDP8870's curves are filled outlines whose steep heads the column sampler served as a few mid-run points; the source outlines run to the top frame (source top y=49 px, plot y0=49). F-v2-1 adds the head row by row on each curve's own outline (row_traced_points_px). No golden point moved or was removed; no readout, label, temperature, I_D value, status or validation changed. The I_D binding provenance changed with the traced heads: 'ID = 35A' now sits nearest its own head (proximity_far_curve_behind_near_curve) and 'ID = 1A' follows by elimination -- the frozen fixture had both by id_order_rule; the values (1 A on c0, 35 A on c1) are the same.

entries.pending: re-bless: F-v3-1 (y axis bound to its printed rules)
entries.why: Frozen with axis_ticks_not_bound_to_grid (PROVENANCE.md, 'batch_all parts'): the shared snap read the rules from the raster, where IR's filled-rectangle rules wobble +-1 px, and refused. F-v3-1 reads the filled rules from the PDF and binds each label to the rule it names (lattice residual 0.56 px). The calibration after frame anchoring is unchanged (every tick within 0.3 px), no point moved, every readout is unchanged (max change 0.0000 %). The only served change: the reason axis_ticks_not_bound_to_grid is gone, so the status is ok.
